mapper.select: SELECT "cd"."operation_designated_date" FROM "calendar_designated_dates" "cd" JOIN "calendars" "c" ON "c"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "c"."calendar_id" = "cd"."calendar_id" WHERE "cd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "cd"."operation_designated_date" > CURRENT_DATE AND "cd"."calendar_id" = #{calendarId}

SELECT "calendar_designated_date_id" , to_char("operation_designated_date", 'YYMMDD') AS "operation_designated_date" FROM "calendar_designated_dates" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "calendar_id" = #{calendarId}

SELECT TO_CHAR("cdd"."operation_designated_date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "operationDesignatedDate" FROM "calendar_designated_dates" AS "cdd" WHERE "cdd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "cdd"."calendar_id" = #{calendarId, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY "cdd"."operation_designated_date" ASC
